author: Nineteenth century videos. Back to life.
description:
Long before modern festivals, there was "Breaking the Pot." This traditional street game, a direct ancestor to the modern piñata, was a centerpiece of community life in the early 1900s.
You can see the tension and excitement as a blindfolded man tries to shatter clay pots suspended in the air, while the crowd—decked out in their finest Sunday hats—watches with a mix of curiosity and joy. It’s a fascinating look at how a simple piece of earthenware and a wooden stick could bring an entire neighborhood together.
title: (1896, 4K, 60fps) Breaking the pot.
